```{r}
# ============================================================
# 20-Year Analysis: 2005-2025
# Step 1: Reshape & Filter to 2005-2025
# ============================================================

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# --- Reshape Fatalities (2005-2025) ---
fatalities_long_20 <- fatalities_20 %>%
  select(Year, Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun,
         Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec) %>%
  mutate(across(Jan:Dec, ~ as.numeric(as.character(.)))) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2005 & Year <= 2025) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = Jan:Dec,
    names_to  = "Month_Name",
    values_to = "Deaths"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = match(Month_Name, month.abb),
    Date  = as.Date(paste(Year, Month, "01", sep = "-"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Deaths)) %>%
  arrange(Date)

# --- Reshape Rainfall (2005-2025) ---
rainfall_long_20 <- rainfall_20 %>%
  select(Year, Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Jun,
         Jul, Aug, Sep, Oct, Nov, Dec) %>%
  mutate(across(Jan:Dec, ~ as.numeric(as.character(.)))) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2005 & Year <= 2025) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = Jan:Dec,
    names_to  = "Month_Name",
    values_to = "Rain_mm"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = match(Month_Name, month.abb),
    Date  = as.Date(paste(Year, Month, "01", sep = "-"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Date)

# --- Check NAs before imputation ---
cat("Total rainfall observations 2005-2025:\n")
print(nrow(rainfall_long_20))

cat("\nMissing rainfall values:\n")
missing_rain <- rainfall_long_20 %>% filter(is.na(Rain_mm))
print(missing_rain %>% select(Year, Month_Name, Date))

# ============================================================
# Step 2: Impute missing rainfall using neighbouring year average
# ============================================================

rainfall_imputed <- rainfall_long_20 %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%  # Group by calendar month to preserve seasonality
  arrange(Year) %>%
  mutate(
    Rain_mm = case_when(
      !is.na(Rain_mm) ~ Rain_mm,  # Keep observed values
      TRUE ~ (lag(Rain_mm) + lead(Rain_mm)) / 2  # Average of prev & next year same month
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Date)

# Check if any NAs remain (e.g. if first or last year is missing)
cat("\nRemaining NAs after imputation:\n")
print(rainfall_imputed %>% filter(is.na(Rain_mm)) %>% select(Year, Month_Name, Date))

# ============================================================
# Step 3: Merge & create final dataset
# ============================================================

df20 <- inner_join(fatalities_long_20, rainfall_imputed,
                   by = c("Year", "Month", "Month_Name", "Date")) %>%
  arrange(Date)

df20$Time <- 1:nrow(df20)

# --- Sanity checks ---
cat("\nFinal dataset dimensions:\n")
print(dim(df20))

cat("\nDate range:\n")
print(range(df20$Date))

cat("\nRemaining NAs:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(df20)))

cat("\nFirst 12 rows:\n")
print(head(df20, 12))


```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper Functions — Run these first
# ============================================================

estimate_transition_matrix <- function(states, state_levels) {
  n <- length(state_levels)
  count_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n,
                         dimnames = list(From = state_levels, To = state_levels))
  states <- as.character(states)
  for (i in 1:(length(states) - 1)) {
    from <- states[i]
    to   <- states[i + 1]
    if (!is.na(from) & !is.na(to) &
        from %in% state_levels & to %in% state_levels) {
      count_matrix[from, to] <- count_matrix[from, to] + 1
    }
  }
  row_sums <- rowSums(count_matrix)
  prob_matrix <- sweep(count_matrix, 1,
                       ifelse(row_sums == 0, 1, row_sums), "/")
  return(list(counts = count_matrix, probs = prob_matrix))
}

get_stationary <- function(P) {
  n  <- nrow(P)
  A  <- t(P) - diag(n)
  A  <- rbind(A, rep(1, n))
  b  <- c(rep(0, n), 1)
  pi <- qr.solve(A, b)
  names(pi) <- colnames(P)
  return(pi)
}

matrix_power <- function(P, n) {
  result <- diag(nrow(P))
  for (i in seq_len(n)) result <- result %*% P
  return(result)
}

cat("Helper functions loaded successfully.\n")

```

# Step 9: Heatmaps

library(reshape2)

plot_transition_heatmap <- function(prob_matrix, title) {
  melted <- melt(prob_matrix)
  colnames(melted) <- c("From", "To", "Probability")
  ggplot(melted, aes(x = To, y = From, fill = Probability)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Probability)),
              size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#EBF5FB", high = "#1A5276", limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = title, x = "To State", y = "From State") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

plot_difference_heatmap <- function(diff_matrix, title) {
  melted <- melt(diff_matrix)
  colnames(melted) <- c("From", "To", "Difference")
  ggplot(melted, aes(x = To, y = From, fill = Difference)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Difference)),
              size = 4.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#C0392B", mid = "white", high = "#1A5276",
                         midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
    labs(title    = title,
         subtitle = "Blue = increased probability | Red = decreased probability",
         x = "To State", y = "From State") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
}

# Individual chain heatmaps

# ============================================================
# Step 10: Mean First Passage Times
# ============================================================

mean_first_passage <- function(P, stat) {
  n   <- nrow(P)
  mfp <- matrix(0, n, n, dimnames = dimnames(P))
  for (j in 1:n) {
    A      <- diag(n) - P
    A[j, ] <- 0
    A[j, j] <- 1
    b      <- rep(1, n)
    b[j]   <- 1 / stat[j]
    mfp[, j] <- solve(A, b)
  }
  return(mfp)
}

fat20_mfp  <- mean_first_passage(fat20_result$probs, fat20_stat)
rain20_mfp <- mean_first_passage(rain20_result$probs, rain20_stat)

cat("=== Fatality Mean First Passage Times (months) ===\n")

print(round(rain20_mfp, 2))

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Missing R Code: Stationarity/Ergodicity + Logit Model
# ============================================================

# ============================================================
# Part 1: Stationarity & Ergodicity Checks
# ============================================================

# --- 1a: Irreducibility Check ---
# A chain is irreducible if every state can reach every other state
# Check: are there any zero rows in the transition matrix?

check_irreducibility <- function(P, state_levels, chain_name) {
  cat("\n===", chain_name, "— Irreducibility Check ===\n")
  
  # Check direct transitions (1-step)
  cat("Zero entries in transition matrix (direct):\n")
  zeros <- which(P == 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(zeros) == 0) {
    cat("None — all states directly reachable from all states\n")
  } else {
    print(zeros)
  }
  
  # Check n-step reachability via matrix power
  # If P^n has all positive entries, chain is irreducible
  P2  <- matrix_power(P, 2)
  P3  <- matrix_power(P, 3)
  
  cat("\nAll entries positive after 2 steps?", all(P2 > 0), "\n")
  cat("All entries positive after 3 steps?", all(P3 > 0), "\n")
  
  if (all(P3 > 0)) {
    cat("CONCLUSION: Chain is IRREDUCIBLE (all states communicate)\n")
  } else {
    cat("CONCLUSION: Chain may NOT be irreducible — check structure\n")
  }
}

check_irreducibility(fat20_result$probs,  fatality_levels, "Fatality Chain")
check_irreducibility(rain20_result$probs, rain_levels,     "Rainfall Chain")
check_irreducibility(joint20_result$probs, joint_levels_20, "Joint Chain")

# --- 1b: Aperiodicity Check ---
# A chain is aperiodic if gcd of return times = 1
# Sufficient condition: if diagonal entries > 0, chain is aperiodic

check_aperiodicity <- function(P, chain_name) {
  cat("\n===", chain_name, "— Aperiodicity Check ===\n")
  diag_vals <- diag(P)
  cat("Diagonal entries (self-transition probabilities):\n")
  print(round(diag_vals, 3))
  
  if (all(diag_vals > 0)) {
    cat("CONCLUSION: Chain is APERIODIC (all diagonal entries > 0)\n")
  } else {
    zero_diag <- names(diag_vals[diag_vals == 0])
    cat("States with zero self-transition:", paste(zero_diag, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    cat("Manual period check required for these states\n")
  }
}

check_aperiodicity(fat20_result$probs,  "Fatality Chain")
check_aperiodicity(rain20_result$probs, "Rainfall Chain")
check_aperiodicity(joint20_result$probs, "Joint Chain")

# --- 1c: Ergodicity Conclusion ---
cat("\n=== Ergodicity Summary ===\n")
cat("A chain is ERGODIC if it is both irreducible AND aperiodic.\n")
cat("Ergodic chains have a unique stationary distribution\n")
cat("and n-step transitions converge to it from any starting state.\n")

# --- 1d: Verify stationary distribution satisfies pi*P = pi ---
cat("\n=== Verification: pi * P = pi (Fatality Chain) ===\n")
pi_fat  <- fat20_stat
piP_fat <- pi_fat %*% fat20_result$probs
cat("pi:    "); print(round(pi_fat, 6))
cat("pi*P:  "); print(round(as.vector(piP_fat), 6))
cat("Max difference:", max(abs(pi_fat - as.vector(piP_fat))), "\n")

cat("\n=== Verification: pi * P = pi (Rainfall Chain) ===\n")
pi_rain  <- rain20_stat
piP_rain <- pi_rain %*% rain20_result$probs
cat("pi:    "); print(round(pi_rain, 6))
cat("pi*P:  "); print(round(as.vector(piP_rain), 6))
cat("Max difference:", max(abs(pi_rain - as.vector(piP_rain))), "\n")

# --- 1e: Eigenvalue check ---
cat("\n=== Eigenvalue Check — Fatality Chain ===\n")
eig_fat <- eigen(t(fat20_result$probs))
cat("Eigenvalues:\n")
print(round(Re(eig_fat$values), 6))
cat("Largest eigenvalue (should be 1.0):", 
    round(max(Re(eig_fat$values)), 6), "\n")
cat("Second eigenvalue (mixing rate):", 
    round(sort(Re(eig_fat$values), decreasing = TRUE)[2], 6), "\n")
cat("Spectral gap (1 - lambda2):", 
    round(1 - sort(Re(eig_fat$values), decreasing = TRUE)[2], 6), "\n")

cat("\n=== Eigenvalue Check — Rainfall Chain ===\n")
eig_rain <- eigen(t(rain20_result$probs))
cat("Eigenvalues:\n")
print(round(Re(eig_rain$values), 6))
cat("Largest eigenvalue:", round(max(Re(eig_rain$values)), 6), "\n")
cat("Second eigenvalue:", 
    round(sort(Re(eig_rain$values), decreasing = TRUE)[2], 6), "\n")
cat("Spectral gap:", 
    round(1 - sort(Re(eig_rain$values), decreasing = TRUE)[2], 6), "\n")

# ============================================================
# Part 2: Logit Model — Formal Hypothesis Test
# ============================================================

cat("\n\n=== LOGIT MODEL ANALYSIS ===\n")

# --- 2a: Binary outcome: High fatality risk (1) vs not (0) ---
df20$High_Risk <- as.integer(df20$Fatality_State == "High")

cat("High risk months:", sum(df20$High_Risk), 
    "out of", nrow(df20), "\n")

# --- 2b: Dummy variables for rainfall regime ---
# Reference category: Normal rainfall
df20$Rain_Dry <- as.integer(df20$Rain_State == "Dry")
df20$Rain_Wet <- as.integer(df20$Rain_State == "Wet")

# --- 2c: State hypothesis ---
cat("\nHypothesis Test:\n")
cat("H0: Rainfall regime has NO effect on probability of High fatality risk\n")
cat("H1: Rainfall regime DOES affect probability of High fatality risk\n")
cat("(Formally: H0: beta_Dry = beta_Wet = 0)\n\n")

# --- 2d: Fit logit model ---
logit_model <- glm(
  High_Risk ~ Rain_Dry + Rain_Wet,
  data   = df20,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)

cat("=== Logit Model: P(High Fatality | Rainfall Regime) ===\n")
print(summary(logit_model))

# --- 2e: Odds ratios ---
cat("=== Odds Ratios (relative to Normal rainfall) ===\n")
odds_ratios <- exp(coef(logit_model))
conf_int    <- exp(confint(logit_model))
or_table <- data.frame(
  Odds_Ratio = round(odds_ratios, 3),
  CI_Lower   = round(conf_int[, 1], 3),
  CI_Upper   = round(conf_int[, 2], 3)
)
print(or_table)

# --- 2f: Likelihood ratio test (joint significance) ---
cat("\n=== Likelihood Ratio Test (H0: beta_Dry = beta_Wet = 0) ===\n")
logit_null <- glm(High_Risk ~ 1, data = df20, 
                  family = binomial(link = "logit"))
lr_test <- anova(logit_null, logit_model, test = "Chisq")
print(lr_test)

# --- 2g: Predicted probabilities by regime ---
cat("\n=== Predicted Probability of High Fatality Risk by Rainfall Regime ===\n")
pred_data <- data.frame(
  Rain_Dry = c(1, 0, 0),
  Rain_Wet = c(0, 0, 1),
  Regime   = c("Dry", "Normal", "Wet")
)
pred_data$Predicted_Prob <- predict(logit_model, 
                                     newdata = pred_data,
                                     type    = "response")
print(pred_data[, c("Regime", "Predicted_Prob")])

# --- 2h: Extended logit with time trend ---
cat("\n=== Extended Logit: Adding Time Trend ===\n")
logit_time <- glm(
  High_Risk ~ Rain_Dry + Rain_Wet + Time,
  data   = df20,
  family = binomial(link = "logit")
)
print(summary(logit_time))

cat("\n=== Model Comparison: AIC ===\n")
cat("Null model AIC:          ", round(AIC(logit_null),  2), "\n")
cat("Rainfall only AIC:       ", round(AIC(logit_model), 2), "\n")
cat("Rainfall + time AIC:     ", round(AIC(logit_time),  2), "\n")

```

# ============================================================
# Visualise all 3 conditional matrices as a 1x3 heatmap grid
# ============================================================

library(gridExtra)
library(reshape2)

plot_cond_heatmap <- function(prob_matrix, title, colour_high) {
  melted <- melt(prob_matrix)
  colnames(melted) <- c("From", "To", "Probability")
  ggplot(melted, aes(x = To, y = From, fill = Probability)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.3f", Probability)),
              size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDFEFE", high = colour_high,
                        limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = title, x = "To State", y = "From State") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))
}

p_dry_h  <- plot_cond_heatmap(fat20_dry$probs,
                               "Dry months",    "#E67E22")
p_norm_h <- plot_cond_heatmap(fat20_normal$probs,
                               "Normal months", "#2980B9")
p_wet_h  <- plot_cond_heatmap(fat20_wet$probs,
                               "Wet months",    "#1A5276")

grid.arrange(p_dry_h, p_norm_h, p_wet_h,
             ncol = 3,
             top  = "Fatality Transition Matrices by Rainfall Regime (2005-2025)")
